key_insight: StreamCacheVGGT replaces binary token eviction with a training‑free, cross‑layer scoring plus hybrid compression scheme that preserves geometric information and yields stable, constant‑memory 3D reconstruction from video streams.
problem_solved: Existing O(1) streaming frameworks destroy useful information by hard‑evicting tokens and using noisy, single‑layer scores, causing unstable dense 3D geometry inference over long video sequences under fixed memory.
method: Cross‑Layer Robust Scoring: aggregate multi‑layer attention/activation signals (and temporal context) to produce stable, global importance scores for tokens instead of relying on single‑layer/localized metrics.

Hybrid Cache Compression: compress less‑important tokens via a mix of soft merging, low‑rank projection and lightweight quantization so information is retained in reduced form rather than being deleted.

Streaming, Training‑Free Integration: a plug‑and‑play cache manager for Visual Geometry Transformers that maintains O(1) memory budget while improving reconstruction stability and reducing evaluation noise.
impact: Enables more reliable, long‑duration dense 3D reconstruction on memory‑constrained devices without retraining, benefiting real‑time robotics, AR/VR, and edge deployment of vision transformer pipelines.
